About

Incorporated in 2014, Osia Hyper Retail Ltd is in the retail business through supermarket chain.[1]

Key Points

Business Overview:[1]
OHRL (formerly known as Mapple Exim Private Limited) is engaged in the retailing of consumer products across categories. The company has ~31 stores spread across various cities in Gujarat, 1 store each in Maharashtra and Uttarakhand, and 2 stores in Uttar Pradesh.
